scientific_integrity: Deterministic exhaustive finite enumeration, complete acyclic Morse matchings, signed integral boundary reconstruction and exact integer lattice calculations; verification script uses SymPy, and no independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The homotopy statement concerns only the open-neighborhood complex of the explicitly defined 29-vertex Paley graph. The dominance-complex corollary is integral-homological only; no all-order Paley theorem or equivalent novelty certification is claimed.
title: Integral homotopy of the Paley-29 open-neighborhood complex
